questions.question: What does chapter 20 give laws about?
Who was exempt from going out to battle?
options: Those with a new house, vineyard, or wife
Those who owned great wealth or many flocks
Those who were old or weak in body
Those who served as priests at the altar
questions.answer: Those with a new house, vineyard, or wife

questions.question: The priest was to encourage the army not to fear, for the LORD goes with them.
Moses said not to fear in battle, for the LORD your God goes with you to _____ for you.
A man who had planted a new _____ and not yet used its fruit could return home.
